# Tide Workshop bookings and cancellations Synthetic demonstration policy. Effective 1 October 2026. ## Equipment bookings Members book equipment through the member portal. The laser cutter has a maximum session length of 90 minutes. The sewing station has a maximum session length of 120 minutes. A member may hold at most two future equipment bookings at a time. Bookings may be made up to 14 days in advance. Required induction and a current endorsement must be completed before making a laser cutter booking. ## Arrival Members must check in with the duty steward before a booked session. Arriving more than 15 minutes late releases the slot to the waiting list. A released late-arrival slot is treated as a late cancellation. The booking ends at its original end time even if a member arrives late. ## Cancellation and refunds Cancel at least 24 hours before the session start to receive a full refund of the equipment booking fee. Cancellations less than 24 hours before the session start receive no refund. Exactly 24 hours before the session qualifies for a full refund.
